securityPolicyPage.title: Security Policy
securityPolicyPage.section1Text: OxSteed uses technical and organizational controls to reduce security risks. No system is completely secure, and this page is not a certification or a guarantee against incidents.
securityPolicyPage.section2List1: Transport: production web connections use HTTPS. Protection also depends on your device, network, and the service you access.
securityPolicyPage.section2List2: Password security: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with per-user salts. OxSteed staff cannot view your password.
securityPolicyPage.section2List3: Authentication: JWT-based authentication with secure, HTTP-only cookies. Tokens expire and are refreshed automatically.
securityPolicyPage.section2List4: Two-factor authentication: Optional TOTP-based 2FA via authenticator apps for account protection.
securityPolicyPage.section2List5: Rate limits and abuse checks help restrict suspicious requests; they cannot prevent every attack.
securityPolicyPage.section2List6: Access checks restrict customer, helper, business, team, support, and administrative actions according to permissions.
securityPolicyPage.section2List7: Server-side validation, authorization checks, and audit records protect sensitive workflows.
securityPolicyPage.section2List8: Security headers and content restrictions help reduce browser-based attacks. Their presence is not a guarantee of complete protection.
securityPolicyPage.section3List1: Payments: Stripe integrations process card payments and connected accounts where available. Direct-payment records and internal credit ledgers have different functions and controls.
securityPolicyPage.section3List2: Verification: identity or screening providers are used only where the relevant feature is offered. A badge is not a guarantee of safety or qualifications.
securityPolicyPage.section3List3: Hosting and delivery: OxSteed operates a containerized application managed through Coolify, with Cloudflare used for web traffic delivery and security.
securityPolicyPage.section3List4: Notifications, storage, maps, and AI: service providers receive the data needed for the selected feature. Their security and privacy terms also apply.
securityPolicyPage.section4Text: If you discover a security vulnerability on OxSteed, we ask that you disclose it responsibly. Please report security issues to:
securityPolicyPage.section4Include1: A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact;
securityPolicyPage.section4Include3: Any relevant screenshots or proof-of-concept code;
securityPolicyPage.section4Response: We review reports and prioritize verified issues by impact. Please provide only the evidence necessary to reproduce the issue and avoid including personal data or secrets.
securityPolicyPage.section4DoNot: Do not access other users' accounts or data, perform denial-of-service attacks, or exploit vulnerabilities beyond what is necessary to demonstrate the issue.
securityPolicyPage.section5List1: Use a strong, unique password for your OxSteed account;
securityPolicyPage.section5List2: Enable two-factor authentication for additional account protection;
securityPolicyPage.section5List3: Do not share your login credentials with anyone;
securityPolicyPage.section5List4: Log out of your account when using shared or public devices;
securityPolicyPage.section5List5: Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account;
securityPolicyPage.section5List6: Keep your browser and operating system up to date.
securityPolicyPage.section6Text: In the event of a security incident that compromises personal data, OxSteed will:
securityPolicyPage.section6List1: Investigate the scope and take steps to contain the incident;
securityPolicyPage.section6List2: Notify affected people when required by applicable law, within the applicable deadlines;
securityPolicyPage.section6List3: Notify applicable state attorneys general as required by law;
securityPolicyPage.section6List4: Provide details about what data was affected and steps users should take;
securityPolicyPage.section7Text: For copyright or other legal concerns, contact:

cookiePolicyPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicyPage.section1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help us remember your preferences, understand how you use our platform, and improve your experience.
cookiePolicyPage.section2Text: OxSteed uses cookies, localStorage, and sessionStorage for sign-in, security, preferences, drafts, and optional integrations. Manage Cookies controls optional integration categories in this browser, not every item of storage used by a feature you request.
cookiePolicyPage.tableEssentialPurpose: Authentication, security tokens, CSRF protection, session management
cookiePolicyPage.tableEssentialDuration: Access: 15 minutes; refresh: normally 7 days, up to 30 days with Remember Me. Other storage varies.
cookiePolicyPage.tableAnalyticsPurpose: Consented pageview events and Google Analytics when configured
cookiePolicyPage.tableMarketingPurpose: Meta Pixel when configured and marketing is allowed
cookiePolicyPage.tableFunctionalPurpose: Additional optional integrations; no extra functional script is currently loaded by this control
cookiePolicyPage.tableFunctionalDuration: Preferences remain until cleared or replaced; other storage varies
cookiePolicyPage.section4Text: When you first visit OxSteed, a cookie banner will ask for your consent. You can:
cookiePolicyPage.section4Choice1: Accept All - Enable all cookie categories
cookiePolicyPage.section4Choice2: Reject All — disable optional integrations; essential and requested-feature storage remains
cookiePolicyPage.section4Choice3: Customize - Choose which categories to enable
cookiePolicyPage.section4Footer: Use Manage Cookies below or in the footer. Choices apply to this browser and do not sync across devices. Clearing browser storage may reset them. Withdrawing consent stops future optional tracking; it does not delete data already sent to a provider.
cookiePolicyPage.section5Text: Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies through their settings. Note that blocking essential cookies may prevent OxSteed from functioning properly.
cookiePolicyPage.section6Text: Some cookies are set by third-party services that appear on our pages. We do not control these cookies. Key third parties include:
cookiePolicyPage.section6ThirdParty1: Google Analytics and Meta Pixel, only when configured and permitted by your choices
cookiePolicyPage.section6ThirdParty2: Payment, security, embedded media, and requested external services may use their own storage under their policies
cookiePolicyPage.section7Text: Global Privacy Control (GPC) disables marketing integrations in this browser, including when saved choices allowed them. Do Not Track (DNT) alone is not an automatic opt-out. Use Manage Cookies for other optional categories or submit a privacy request for account-related choices.
cookiePolicyPage.section8Text: Under the CCPA, you have the right to opt out of the sale of your personal information. If marketing cookies are enabled in the future, they may constitute a "sale" under CCPA. Visit our
cookiePolicyPage.section8Link: Do Not Sell My Personal Information
cookiePolicyPage.section9Text: Updates are posted with a revised date. Continuing to browse does not by itself grant consent to optional tracking.
cookiePolicyPage.section10Text: Questions about our cookie practices? Contact us at

doNotSellPage.title: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
doNotSellPage.doesNotSellYourDataTitle: Your sale, sharing, and advertising choices
doNotSellPage.doesNotSellText1: Optional advertising integrations, including Meta Pixel when configured, can disclose browser activity to advertising providers. Depending on applicable law, that disclosure may be considered sharing or sale. You can disable marketing in Manage Cookies and submit an opt-out request here.
doNotSellPage.doesNotSellText2: GPC disables marketing in this browser. Submitting the form records a request for review; it does not instantly change every account or third-party record. It also disables marketing locally. Other optional categories remain under your cookie choices.
doNotSellPage.rightsIntro: Where applicable law grants these rights, you may:
doNotSellPage.rightsItem1: Know what personal information is collected and how it is used;
doNotSellPage.rightsItem3: Opt out of sale, sharing, or targeted advertising, as applicable;
doNotSellPage.rightsItem4: Non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights.
doNotSellPage.otherStateLawsText: OxSteed also respects privacy rights under the Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), Connecticut Data Privacy Act (CTDPA), and other applicable state privacy laws. If you are a resident of any of these states, you may exercise your rights by contacting us at the address below.
doNotSellPage.contactIntro: If you have questions about this page or wish to exercise any privacy rights, please contact us at:
doNotSellPage.formIntro: You do not need an account to submit an opt-out request. Provide an email so we can identify the request and follow up. We handle requests within applicable legal deadlines. For other privacy rights, contact privacy@oxsteed.com.
doNotSellPage.notesPlaceholder: Tell us anything that helps us find your data.

accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityPage.overview: OxSteed is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually work to improve the user experience for everyone and apply the relevant accessibility standards.
accessibilityPage.conformance: WCAG Level AA is our accessibility target, not a claim of complete conformance. Automated and browser checks cover selected flows. They do not establish that every page, uploaded file, video, third-party widget, or assistive technology combination is accessible.

measures.one: Semantic headings, form labels, and landmarks in maintained interfaces;
measures.two: Theme contrast checks and visible focus styles in tested components;
measures.three: Keyboard interaction tests for selected navigation, dialogs, and workflows;
measures.four: ARIA labels and roles where appropriate;
measures.five: Responsive design that works across screen sizes and zoom levels.

accessibilityPage.feedback: If you experience any accessibility issues or barriers while using OxSteed, please contact us. We take accessibility feedback seriously and will work to address any concerns promptly.
accessibilityPage.responseTime: Please include the page, task, device, browser, and assistive technology if relevant. Tell us the alternative format or assistance you need. We review reports and prioritize barriers affecting access.

cookieConsent.title: Cookie Preferences
cookieConsent.desc: Choose optional integrations for this browser. Essential storage stays active. Basic settings and drafts are separate. Changes do not erase data already sent.
cookieConsent.essentialDesc: Required for the platform to function. Includes authentication, security, and session management.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Consented pageview events and Google Analytics when configured
cookieConsent.marketingDesc: Meta Pixel when configured and marketing is allowed
cookieConsent.functionalDesc: Additional optional integrations; no extra functional script is currently loaded by this control
cookieConsent.bannerText: We use cookies to improve your experience on OxSteed. Essential cookies are required for the platform to work. You can customize your preferences or accept all cookies.
cookieConsent.gpc: Global Privacy Control is on. Marketing stays off.
